title: Multiplying and Dividing Fractions
summary: Fraction of a fraction as an area, and division as “how many fit?”. Why dividing by 1/2 doubles.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 8: Working with Fractions
Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Fractions and Decimals

objectives: I can multiply fractions and explain it with an area model.
I can divide fractions using reciprocals.
I can solve real-life problems with fraction multiplication and division.
misconceptions: Multiplying always makes a number bigger.
Dividing always makes a number smaller.
To divide fractions, flip the first fraction.
